title: M2Health AI Assistant
heroBody: Tell me what's bothering you, and I'll help you understand what you can do next.
privacyDetail: Your conversation is private. Health details are encrypted and handled in line with our Privacy Policy (PDPA / HIPAA aligned). You can review or delete this chat anytime.
disclaimerBody: This AI Assistant provides general information only and does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. If you have a medical emergency, please seek urgent medical care.
newConversationBody: This conversation will be kept in your history as read-only.
deleteBody: This conversation will be deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
micDeniedBody: Microphone permission has been denied. Please enable it in your device Settings to use voice input.
